function narrowed() {
  let value: string | number = 'text';
  const copy: typeof value = 1;
}
function member(value: {item: string | number}) {
  if (typeof value.item === 'string') { const copy: typeof value.item = 1; }
}
function unassigned() {
  let value: number;
  const copy: typeof value = undefined;
  let empty;
  const number: typeof empty = 1;
}
function captures() {
  let value: string | number = 'text';
  const arrow = () => { const copy: typeof value = 1; return copy; };
}
function nullable(value: string | undefined) {
  if (value) { const copy: typeof value = undefined; }
}
function snapshot() {
  let value: string | number = 'initial';
  type Initial = typeof value;
  value = 1;
  const copy: Initial = 2;
}
